messages:
maria-evans: Heads-up — Helix Therapeutics private deployment needs final signoff. Target change window: 2026-06-12 02:00-04:00 UTC (maintenance). :calendar:

maria-evans: Summary: migrate Helix to Dedicated v2 runtime, pin model to 1.3.2-quant, enable prefix KV cache, and apply customer-specific network ACLs. Plan + rollback below.

alex-choi: ACK the window. Couple quick Qs: are we pinning weights or config only? and is there a read-only fallback model?

maria-evans: Pin both weights and runtime config. Fallback: model v1.3.1-std (lower perf, same API). Rollback triggers: >5% 5m error rate or latency P95 > 800ms for 10m.

jonah-baker: I ran the preflight smoke on staging with the exact pin, looks clean. Noted a small mem spike at long context (>8k) but within margin.

sara-ops: Ops checklist uploaded: https://redwood.internal/sre/checklists/helix-2026-06-12 — includes capacity verification and KMS key rotation note. Please review.

maria-evans: Release notes draft: https://docs.internal/releases/helix-2026-06-12.md (contains customer-facing blurb + internal troubleshooting tips).

amelia-helix: Thanks, team — Helix side good with the window if we can guarantee no key rotation during window. Their security lead will be on standby.

alex-choi: Noted. KMS rotation will be scheduled outside this window.

deploy-bot: @maria-evans deployment-request received for helix/tenant-id: hlx-998 on 2026-06-12 02:00 UTC. CI checks: passed. Queued for manual approval.

maria-evans: Approving the deploy request now. Approvers: @alex-choi, @jonah-baker, @sara-ops — please react with :thumbsup: to approve or :thumbsdown: to block.

alex-choi: :thumbsup:

jonah-baker: :thumbsup:

sara-ops: :thumbsup: leaving on-call for the window.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled. Steps: 1) scale to 4 nodes pinned; 2) apply model 1.3.2-quant; 3) run smoke tests; 4) cut traffic over 10% steps. Post-deploy tests: latency/accuracy baseline.

maria-evans: Rollback playbook (condensed):
```
- If >5% 5m errors or P95>800ms for 10m -> trigger rollback
- Command: `rwctl rollout revert --tenant hlx-998 --to-tag v1.3.1-std`
- Notify customer and set postmortem channel
```

alex-choi: I'll own the rollback command if needed. sara-ops will handle infra-side scaling. jonah will validate model outputs.

amelia-helix: Helix will monitor with us. Please ping on Slack + Pager if rollback is needed.

maria-evans: Final question: can we get a brief canary at +10% for 30m then proceed? deploy-bot already listed staged cut.

sara-ops: Yes — canary 10% for 30m, escalate if anomalies. I’ll set alerts: error-rate, token-cost spike, and end-to-end latency.

deploy-bot: Canary policy applied: 10% for 30m, auto-hold on alert thresholds. Notification channel: #incidents-helix.

maria-evans: Great — with approvals in thread and controls in place I’ll mark this ready-to-execute. Final step: @deploy-bot please add a 1-hour preflight reminder 1hr before window.

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled for 2026-06-12 01:00 UTC. Good luck! :rocket:
